title: AI Factory real local model assists approved v1 by deriving worker recovery workload metric
description: Given value, a list of synthetic CODEN Worker task-state strings, produce one integer counting all entries exactly equal to 'lease_expired' or 'cancel_requested', counting duplicates separately. Ignore 'active', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'blocked', 'recovered', empty and other values. Start count = 0. Use a simple for status in value loop and TWO INDEPENDENT if statements: one status == 'lease_expired' and a different if status == 'cancel_requested'; increment count for each exact match and return count. Do not use boolean or/and, membership checks, comprehensions, imports, helper functions, filesystem, network, approvals, retries or external services. Create only def transform(value):. This is a read-only recovery-workload metric for founder-approved CODEN Factory v1 section 51, NOT permission to cancel, retry or run workers.
